ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-orange soft scrambled-looking mass with fluffy, curd-like clumps and folded ridges, moist-looking with slight sheen, crumbly and soft (not holding a sharp shape), spread across roughly 40% of the white square plate's right-center area, clumps about 1-3 cm each, with a few darker golden edges and a small loose fragment at the lower left of the plate | 150

ITEM 2 | Small single loose pale yellow crumb-like piece, about 1 cm across, soft and matte, sitting separately on the white plate at the lower left of the main pile | 4

ITEM 3 | Thin darker brown streak visible beneath the yellow mass in the center, glossy and slightly wet-looking, appears to be a small smear on the plate surface, roughly 3 cm long | 3
